title: Novel 'Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau.' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Aito Aoyagi 's Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau. ( Little Red Riding Hood… ) novel on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Chaos Breaker Trailer Arc Trailer Revealed, Begins on August 16
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a trailer for the Chaos Breaker arc, which will begin with Episode 8 on August 16. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi' Reveals Main Cast, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga revealed the main cast, a key visual (pictured right), and the first promotional video on Monday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime's Video Unveils Cast, October 3 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga unveiled on Monday the anime's first promotional video, main visual, cast members, and October 3 premiere.

title: Shiori Teshirogi Launches Manga Miniseries in September
content: The September issue of Akita Shoten 's Mystery Bonita magazine announced on August 6 that manga creator Shiori Teshirogi and her younger brother and novelist Shōtarō Teshirogi will launch a four-chapter manga miniseries titled Fushigiri Muichi (Muichi the Slayer of Immortals) in the magazine's next issue on September…

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Confirms 3 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga confirmed three more cast members on Monday. The film's staff also announced that the film will screen in MX4D, 4DX, and Dolby Cinema starting on August 21.
author: ANN

title: Cat Companions Maruru and Hachi Manga Returns From Hiatus
content: Sonoda put the manga on hiatus in January 2025 due to health reasons. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story: An odd couple of stray cats team up to share the trials and tribulations of life in this heartwarming manga.
author: ANN

title: Twin Engine, Bandai Form Strategic Partnership to Co-Create New IPs
content: Animation production and planning company Twin Engine and Bandai have entered a strategic partnership aimed at jointly creating and developing new intellectual properties (IPs), with the two companies planning to invest up to 4 billion yen (approximately US$25.25 million) in manga development and animation production.
author: MyAnimeList
